svg.title: From the car to optional PDK
svg.desc: Optional PDK sits behind the 2010 2.9 engine and drives both rear wheels. Its electronic controller is separate, in the rear-right luggage-compartment area. The flywheel feeds two nested clutch packs and concentric input shafts. Gear selection and clutch pressure are separate hydraulic tasks; both drive paths reach the final drive. Numbered parts: 1 Dual-mass flywheel; 2 K1 and inner shaft; 3 K2 and hollow shaft; 4 Gears and selectors; 5 Final drive and outputs; 6 Hydraulic valve block; 7 Separate PDK controller; 8 External oil cooler. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
